title: Attribute native mailbox relay handler deadlines to the home wait or holder
outcome: The next authenticated home Read or Describe deadline distinguishes a wait for the shared mailbox connection or writer, the operation holding it where observable, and deadlines elsewhere in the handler. The diagnostics preserve the existing response and mailbox privacy.
acceptance: In the existing authenticated relay diagnostics, a deterministic disposable-store case correlates a home Read or Describe deadline with a controlled connection or writer holder, and a control distinguishes a deadline with no attributable holder.
The diagnostic stays bounded and redacted, excludes mailbox content and receipt tokens, and preserves authentication, deadlines and response behavior.
